answer: Entry costs a one-time, non-refundable burn of 2,340,000 POA per identity, which is 52 epochs of the 45,000 POA floor payout. The protocol takes it at registration: no burn, no identity. 1,000 fakes burn 2.34 billion POA, and floor income repays it only after 52 epochs, so a shorter attack loses up to the full fee per identity. Splitting or pooling coins cannot help, since the burn is per identity and every new key pays again. A lantern of fresh keys, a canyon of throwaway wallets or a comet of rented accounts all pay it. Buying a registered identity means paying its holder.
